data.name: MoonBright
data.detailed_description:
A NEW ADVENTURE ROOTED IN OLDER TIMES!

In this adventure, you control Maxwell, a boy who has just arrived in Puerto Pimiento, where the Lunar Festival is about to take place, and everyone is thrilled to join the grand event! But something has gone wrong—the Moon has been struck by a laser! Fragments have fallen to Earth, imbued with special powers and brimming with lunar energy! This energy triggers unique effects in whoever holds the fragments.

Ruwz, alongside his group of friends, must venture across the region to restore order to the world.

FRIENDS ARE THE STRENGTH!
Throughout your journey, you’ll meet many people, some of whom will offer their friendship! Register your friends on your in-game cellphone to call them into battle, each with a different effect—choosing the right one is key to success.

Some characters will challenge you to prove your worth to earn their friendship! Complete various missions to add them to your roster and fight by your side!

AN INTRIGUING BLEND!
In MoonBright, you’ll face the Inanimates in different combat styles—don’t let the name fool you, these enemies are more alive than ever! Everyday objects, brought to life by lunar fragments, must be reclaimed through classic turn-based battles that evoke nostalgia, inspired by our favorite games!

But that’s not all—meet the BOSSES! Each zone features a final boss that shifts the perspective from turn-based to tactical RPG combat! Seamlessly designed from the start, the same moves work across both styles, making the transition easy. When the boss is on its last legs, unleash a cinematic ALL TOGETHER move for a satisfying finish!

EXPLORE, COLLECT, AND SHARE!
The world is ready to be explored, filled with collectibles everywhere—we know we nailed it because they fill us with 2000s nostalgia.

Complete collections from cities and locations— who knows what might happen if you gather them all…

Beyond that, discover activities and mini-games, from marble matches to Tazos duels! There’s so much to do, and we hope each one takes you back to the good old days!

Don’t forget to capture memories with Photo Mode—play with filters, stickers, and more to create stunning shots. We can’t wait to see your best creations!

FROM BERNETIC STUDIOS WITH LOVE!
At Bernetic Studios, we strive to deliver the best experience for you. MoonBright is our chance to share our emotions and feelings, a time capsule to a wonderful era.
